behavior: Recent agreeing images survive isolated rejects; selected capture time belongs to an actual inlier, never the newest rejected sample.

Predict/separated estimator starts from the consensus mean with zero base velocity. Raw history remains the newest actual inlier to avoid a false centroid-to-image velocity on the first live update. Direct mode retains raw-pose semantics.

No automatic restart after an actual motion stop. Encoder freshness, robot drift, watchdog, speed/acceleration, clearance and operator-stop checks remain active.
